headline: Tokyo Core Inflation Hits 16-Month High, Strengthening Case for BOJ Rate Hike
summary: Annual core inflation in Tokyo accelerated in November at its fastest pace in 16 months, bolstering expectations for a Bank of Japan interest rate hike as early as next month.
why: Tokyo's core inflation serves as a leading indicator for nationwide trends in Japan, directly influencing Bank of Japan monetary policy shifts.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Accelerating core inflation builds pressure on the central bank to raise interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected price pressures in the capital raised market expectations that the central bank will tighten monetary policy.
